# Akman--Sissokho Steiner erratum record

Source: Fusun Akman and Papa A. Sissokho, *Erratum: Steiner Coset Partitions
of Groups*, Canadian Mathematical Bulletin 69 (2026), no. 2, 702.

DOI: https://doi.org/10.4153/S0008439525101392

Publisher online date: 2025-11-07. The publisher supplies a calendar date but
no time or time zone, so no UTC or JST time is inferred.

Reviewed: 2026-08-03 JST (UTC+09:00).

The erratum restricts a commuting-subgroup assertion to the stated small-r
cases. It does not imply an arbitrary-group result through seventeen cells.
